Here's a recap of the match between Kestrel Bay FC and Northmere Athletic:

What a match it was at Kestrel Bay Stadium! Kestrel Bay FC were initially on top, but trailed before a pivotal moment swung the game in their favor. With 15 minutes to go, Northmere Athletic were in control but failed to capitalize on their lead. Ilya Orrin's penalty in the 86th minute sealed the deal, giving Kestrel Bay FC the lead. However, a quick turnaround is just what happened when Aaron Varga scored the winner in the 90+4th minute. Northmere Athletic had built a 21-point win probability that they unfortunately didn't manage to turn into victory.

This outcome showcased the team's resilience and composure, as they managed to gain possession with 61% during the match. Meanwhile, Northmere Athletic struggled to create clear chances, with only 2 shots on target to show for it. The turning point of the game, though came when Ilya Orrin converted a penalty, increasing their win probability from 0% to 100%.
